ULTRADNS_ENDPOINT.title: ULTRADNS_ENDPOINT
ULTRADNS_ENDPOINT.description: API endpoint URL, defaults to https://api.ultradns.com/

ULTRADNS_POLLING_INTERVAL.title: ULTRADNS_POLLING_INTERVAL
ULTRADNS_POLLING_INTERVAL.description: Time between DNS propagation check in seconds (Default: 4)

ULTRADNS_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT.title: ULTRADNS_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT
ULTRADNS_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT.description: Maximum waiting time for DNS propagation in seconds (Default: 120)

ULTRADNS_TTL.title: ULTRADNS_TTL
ULTRADNS_TTL.description: The TTL of the TXT record used for the DNS challenge in seconds (Default: 120)
